## A — Communication and speed adjustment
The selected source is the Montana Driver Manual, with the cover revision recorded in the pinned source registry [A01].
The agency named in the back matter is the Montana Department of Justice, Motor Vehicle Division [A02].
The selected applicant path is the non-commercial Class D license described in the licensing chapter [A03].
Official question count, passing standard and time limit are unknown in the safe model view; no values are asserted (verify MT-sec10-COUNT, MT-sec10-PASS, MT-sec10-TIME).
The cover and back cover have conflicting revision statements; the cover was used at registration, with edition reconciliation still open (verify MT-sec10-EDITION).
Scope of this dossier: Communication and speed adjustment; the map selects only the applicable Class D paragraphs. Quiz mastery is an authored product policy and does not establish an official passing requirement.
